verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਕੈ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj majan kai dhib dheh mahaa mal mootr dhaaree nira(n)kaaree keene hai(n) ||

en.bdb: Bathing in the holy dust of the True Guru's feet, the body of an individual acquires golden hue. One who is evil of thoughts, becomes Guru-oriented and divine of temperaments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal charanaamirat nidhaan paan tiragun ateet cheet aapaa aap cheene hai(n) ||

en.bdb: By relishing the elixir of the True Guru's feet, the mind is freed from the triple traits of maya (mammon). He then recognises his self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਔ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal nij aasan si(n)ghaasan kai tirabhavan aau tirakaal ga(n)mitaa prabeene hai(n) ||

en.bdb: By instilling the lotus-like holy feet of the True Guru in self, I.e. mind, one becomes aware of all the three times and the three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਰੂਪ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੩੮॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal ras ga(n)dh roop seetalataa dhuteeaa naasat ek Tek liv leene hai(n) ||338||

en.bdb: By relishing the coolness, sweetness, fragrance and beauty of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, the duality disappears from the mind. One remains absorbed in the refuge and support of the holy feet (of the True Guru). (338)
